name: Love And Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that love and marriage are divinely ordained institutions designed for companionship, unity, and mutual support, as God made a suitable helper for man and established marriage as a union where two become one flesh (Genesis 2:18, 24). Marriage is portrayed as a blessing and a source of favor from the Lord, with a virtuous wife being of great value (Proverbs 18:22, 31:10). This sacred relationship reflects Christ’s love for the church, calling wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, grounded in God’s ultimate love demonstrated through the gift of His Son (Ephesians 5:22; John 3:16).
